claims: The matchup was a second-round game in the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament.
Michigan Wolverines were the No. 2 seed.
NC State Wolfpack were the No. 7 seed.
Michigan Wolverines defeated NC State Wolfpack 92-63.
The game was played at Crisler Center in Ann Arbor, MI.
Crisler Center is Michigan's home floor.
NC State played without injured star Zoe Brooks.
Olivia Olson scored 27 points for Michigan.
Syla Swords scored 26 points for Michigan.
Brooke Quarles Daniels had 5 steals for Michigan.
Michigan outscored NC State 35-5 off turnovers.
Michigan outscored NC State 64-38 in the second half.
Michigan led NC State by 12 at halftime.
The win advanced Michigan to the Sweet 16.
